inlines.v: LIB'ERALLY, adverb 1. Bountifully; freely; largely; with munificence. If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, who giveth to all men liberally and upbraideth not. James 1:5. 2. With generous and impartial regard to other interests than our own; with enlarged views; without selfishness or meanness; as, to think or judge liberally of men and their actions. 3. Freely; not strictly; not literally.
